newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai government still negotiating rubber purchase.
newsitem.headline: Thai government still negotiating rubber purchase.

text.p: The Thai government has still not concluded a deal to buy 7,000 tonnes of rubber because of high offer prices, a source at the southern Hat Yai rubber auction market said on Monday.
"We just received a letter from the buyer today, stressing the desirable price level is 123.5 US cents a kg," the source told Reuters.
But the lowest price offered on Friday was already higher than that sought by the government as offers ranged between 124-128 US cents, he said.
"There might not be any deal if sellers refuse to lower the prices," he added.
The Thai government has already bought 8,000 tonnes of RSS3 in two tranches, both at 123.5 cent per kg.
